title: Derive Issue Router planning and lifecycle from marked statuses
description: Replace exact status-key role lookups with the router-marked status for each semantic category. Dispatch only issues in the marked todo status; move claimed packages to marked in_progress, completed agent work to marked in_review, blocked or cancelled work to marked blocked, and approved completion to marked done. Keep successful agent results in review rather than closing them. Resolve WIP counts, recovery order, retries, requested-change flow, terminal handling, events, plan output, and publication against these same configured statuses. Ensure other statuses sharing a semantic category, including unmarked Ready and Backlog, are not treated as router intake or destinations. Acceptance: Python and Rust behavior matches the shared Gherkin and existing router lifecycle contracts.
